objective.value: Support collaborative project management with AI assistance embedded in workflows — not as a detached chatbot surface.

role.value: Primary Developer — full-stack architecture, MERN stack, authentication and authorization, collaboration, analytics, AI assistant integration, APIs, and database architecture.

repositoryNote.value: Public repository (Project-Management-System) with React client, Node/Express backend, and MongoDB models for users, projects, and tasks.

problem.value: Teams need project and task collaboration with analytics, while AI assistance must stay inside product workflows — retrieve, summarize, automate — rather than exist as a standalone chatbot product.

overview.value: A collaborative project management system with AI assistance placed inside product workflows. The AI surface supports work in context rather than operating as a standalone chat product.

architecture.value: MERN architecture with clear separation between application logic and AI. React client; Node/Express services; MongoDB persistence; JWT authentication; business logic on the backend; AI reached through defined APIs and modular services so assistant behavior does not collapse into the core domain model.

decisions.value: Keep application logic and AI on separate sides of defined APIs: core domain (users, projects, tasks, auth) lives in modular backend services; the assistant integrates through those boundaries instead of embedding model calls inside domain persistence.

timeline.value: Repository archaeology (Project-Management-System): 17 commits all dated 2025-05-11 — initial commit; update pages/routes/images; env variable setup iterations; network update commits. Public history is a single-day publish/configure window rather than a multi-week visible chronology.

decisionRecords.value: ADR-01 (Identity §18.3.4): MERN with AI-assisted productivity inside workflows (not a standalone chatbot). ADR-02 (Identity): React client; Node/Express services; MongoDB; JWT; business logic on the backend; AI via well-defined APIs; modular services; clear separation of application logic and AI. Alternative-rejection log Missing.
